0022600174.text: The Atlanta Hawks (4-4, 3-2 on the road, winners of their last game) are 2nd in the Southeast, 0.5 games back, and 7th in the East as they visit the Washington Wizards (4-3, winners of their last two, 1st in the Southeast and 6th in the East) for their ninth game of the season. Atlanta is without Henri Veesaar (knee), Jock Landale (hip), and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture), while Jalen Johnson is day-to-day with an ankle injury, and Washington is missing Jamir Watkins (knee surgery), Justin Champagnie (foot), Reece Beekman (shoulder), and Tristan Vukcevic (hip, pinched nerve), with Alex Sarr (knee soreness) and Bilal Coulibaly (illness) also day-to-day. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Hawks won the 2025-26 series 3-1, including a 126-96 win in Atlanta on February 26, 2026.
